chn-courtyard-default-11.things: In the back room: a long red wooden altar table against the rear wall holding a blue-and-white porcelain vase and a central lantern; two red armchairs with blue seat cushions in front of it; three blue-and-white porcelain floor jars in the back-right corner; a small wooden stand with a bonsai plant in the back-left corner; a hanging landscape scroll on the back wall; wooden standing screens along the side walls; a partition wall with a central red double door with gold studs. In the courtyard: a perforated scholar's rock (Taihu stone) on an ornamental base in the center; a round stone table surrounded by four stone stools to the west; two green ceramic bowls with water lilies/lotus pads flanking the entrance; a tiled-roof spirit screen (shadow wall) in the southeast; five potted trees in green glazed planters along the edges.
chn-courtyard-default-11.focal: Scholar's rock (Taihu stone) on a carved pedestal in the center of the courtyard
problems: Potted trees are flat 2D billboard cutouts with no 3D thickness, appearing as paper-thin lines from directly above
Two identical potted plants are placed directly adjacent to each other on the right edge (doubled)
The spirit screen (shadow wall) stands isolated in the southeast corner rather than shielding the doorway
The courtyard has no exterior walls on three sides, with the tiled floor ending abruptly over the empty background grid
Any potential text, calligraphy, or symbols on the hanging scroll, door plaques, and spirit screen relief are indistinct and unreadable
A stone stool clips tightly against the round stone table edge

chn-hall-default-11.culture: Traditional Chinese (Ming or Qing dynasty style)
chn-hall-default-11.things: A long red wooden scroll table against the rear (north) wall holding a blue-and-white porcelain vase and a flat grey circular dish; two red wooden armchairs with blue cushions in front of the desk facing south; a hexagonal/octagonal lantern hovering in the center between the chairs; a small wooden stand with a potted bonsai plant in the northwest corner; three blue-and-white porcelain jars on the floor in the northeast corner; a hanging landscape scroll on the northeast wall; two red standing screens along the west and east walls; and a studded red wooden entrance door on the south wall.
chn-hall-default-11.focal: The long red wooden table/desk centered against the back wall.
problems: The lantern is floating in mid-air with no ceiling, cord, chain, or stand supporting it.
The south door is inconsistent between views: upright in the doorway in view-1, but lying flat on the ground outside the threshold in view-2.
The standing screen on the east wall clips into the wall frame and obstructs the wall opening.
The two armchairs are positioned in front of the desk facing away from it rather than being tucked under or facing the desk.
